emerging_watch: Watch whether Semiconductor durability_bar (currently 0.33, eligible=false, breadth 0.045) rises above 0.5 on rising breadth — that structural improvement would be the first sign of a confirmed leadership handoff away from the crowded Banks one-narrative; the watch retires if Banks remains eligible with durability_bar >= 0.7 through the next two prints.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the only theme simultaneously passing the absolute-trend eligibility gate and showing genuine lead-durability (durability_bar 0.75, hurst_tag trend, breadth 0.833). This is a mean-reverting market (gate_helps=false) where crowding is a size-down caution only, so rather than fading the sole eligible leader, the conditional read is to remain with it only while the trend tag persists — recognizing the detector ranks leadership flow, not future returns.
theses.dissent: crowding_z 1.82 and one_narrative=true mean the theme is extremely crowded and absorption is only 0.37; in a mean-reverting tape, a crowded one-narrative leader is the classic whipsaw risk, and the unscheduled-surprise share is 0.91 — headline noise can break the trend quickly.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS prints a lower weekly close while hurst_tag flips off 'trend' before the check-by date

theses.thesis: Gold Miners rank 2 in score but fail the eligibility gate (eligible=false) with weak durability (0.38) and very thin breadth (0.167), so it is a high-score name with no confirmed trend structure. The rotation radar flags it as the challenger, but rotation timing has no validated edge; the margin over Banks (0.227) is not a handoff signal.
theses.dissent: In a mean-reverting tape, the second-highest momentum score with fresh flow could rotate up if Banks' crowding unwinds; avoiding it may miss an early recovery leg.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners score rises above 0.8 and durability_bar sustains above 0.6 for two consecutive prints before the check-by date

In a narrow, one-narrative tape where the trend gate adds no drawdown protection, holding a second eligible theme with weaker trend-health offers little conditional advantage over the dominant leader.
theses.dissent: Its eligibility is notable in a field where only 2 of 22 themes pass the gate; if Banks whipsaws, Pharma & CXO is the only other gated candidate and could absorb rotation flow.
